lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1701: the world tells you where the power is

Owner's direction after his progression assessment: do not rebalance
progression; surface the existing progression ecosystem. The Arbiter
recognises repeated failure or flight from high-tier Hunts and Core
Guardians and reminds the player, in the world's own voice, that the
hunts, the Crucible and the Great Climbs are where power comes from -
suggestions and world knowledge, never gates, never the Beacon Rifle
recipe outright.

engine/progressionHints.ts holds every line and every trigger, keyed off
state the store already keeps:

  * after a Guardian flee - silent the first time, from the second wall
    on once a game-day (24h), three variants: a Common/Uncommon blade
    past the third Core points at the Crucible; a chart-unlocked climb
    points at the Towers; otherwise the posted hunts. The count is the
    mq_guardian_fled ledger plus Guardian deaths.
  * the death writes its killer: worldMemory.lastDeath {enemyName,
    locationId, hour, guardian} and guardianDeaths, from
    handlePlayerDeath (the active enemy at the moment of the kill). The
    Resurrection Gem path speaks the Arbiter's word once for a Guardian
    kill and clears lastDeath.
  * after a hunt's apex sends the player off for the second time (the
    deed ledger's fled-with-hpLeft records), once a game-day.
  * first arrival at a chart-unlocked Great Climb (once per climb a
    session, never once crested): "the things guarding those summits
    carry relics worth bleeding for."
  * the first Aether Collection Beacon: "Five old collectors, if the
    stories are true. Makes you wonder what someone clever could build
    from the set." - the rifle is not named.
  * at the Core seat from the sixth Core on, with the power matchup in
    danger: "Tartaria is full of people who died proving they were
    stubborn." The Guardian has already risen; the line appends only.
  * two greeting doors: a smith (vendors.json title smith / forge /
    armourer / ironhand / anvil) recognises the beacon in the pack once
    - "in no ore I know"; a familiar or trusted counter passes on what
    the climbers brought down, once in three game-days, only while a
    known climb stands uncrested.

Cooldowns are module state in game hours, as arbiterNudge holds its
bounty nudge: no save migration, resets on reload. Nothing here refuses
anything; every hook is consulted after the decision it comments on.

gameStore.ts holds at 36,998 lines (two folds and a trimmed OTA-1700
comment pay for the six hooks). typecheck:tests baseline 201 unchanged.

Suite ota1701TheWorldTellsYouWhereThePowerIs: builders (first wall
silent, second speaks, cooldown, the three variants, the rifle never
named in code), the death writes a Guardian killer and the revive reads
it (a Mud Wasp counts as no wall), the stubborn line and its 'danger'
precondition on a real tier-7 Guardian, the smith and the counter, the
six hooks pinned in place, the ratchet.

Also carried: the contrary-walker sweep hardening from step 3 of the
Narrative Agency plan (test-utils/contraryWalker.ts, playerWalker.ts,
ota1699 sweep, ota1686 pin 'partial' -> 'yes') - a per-road twenty-minute
deadline, an abort token read in Walker.tap so an abandoned road cannot
keep driving the store under the next hunt, stepOffAndBack exits a
building or outpost first, the flee grader reads both pools by inclusion,
the brood is hardened to 200 HP on the brood probe. Test-side only.
